_about: Every outside company whose servers a visitor's browser reaches from this site: the template's own code (when: always, scroll, consent) and the advertising tags it writes from Site Settings' IDs (when: ads, with each ID's shape and the click IDs its tag reads from a landing page's address) and the platform's standard pastes in Studio, which load with the page once pasted (when: paste). The firm's privacy policy is drafted from this list (monorepo BI/rules/legal-pages.md, the LEGAL family). The scrub guard (scripts/check-template-is-blank.mjs) fails the build on any real host the template names that its PLATFORM_HOSTS does not allow, and lib/__tests__/outsideVendors.test.ts fails when an allowed host is neither a vendor here nor in linkOnly with a reason: so a new outside script cannot merge without its vendor. A host is a hostname or *.suffix. Adding a vendor adds a company to every firm's privacy policy: say so in the pull request.

vendors.name: Sanity
vendors.purpose: stores the website's content and delivers its images
vendors.receives: IP address and browser details, with each image request

vendors.name: YouTube (Google)
vendors.purpose: plays videos, in its privacy-enhanced mode
vendors.receives: IP address and browser details; a video's preview image loads before play, and the player may set or read cookies

vendors.name: Vimeo
vendors.purpose: plays videos, with its do-not-track setting
vendors.receives: IP address and browser details; essential player cookies

vendors.name: Google Analytics
vendors.purpose: measures how visitors use the website, only after a visitor accepts
vendors.receives: pages visited, time on them, referrer, device and browser, approximate location from the IP address; sets cookies

vendors.name: Fillout
vendors.purpose: provides the contact form; form messages are stored for the firm in Zite
vendors.receives: what the visitor types into the form, IP address and browser details

vendors.name: Google Maps
vendors.purpose: shows an office's location on a map
vendors.receives: IP address and browser details; may set or read cookies

vendors.name: Elfsight
vendors.purpose: shows the firm's Google reviews in a widget

vendors.name: Meta (Facebook)
vendors.purpose: measures the firm's ads and shows them to past visitors, only after a visitor accepts advertising
vendors.receives: pages visited, device and browser, IP address and the ad that brought the visitor; sets cookies; never what is typed into a form

vendors.name: Google Ads
vendors.purpose: measures the firm's ads and shows them to past visitors, only after a visitor accepts advertising
vendors.receives: pages visited, device and browser, IP address and the ad that brought the visitor; sets cookies; never what is typed into a form

vendors.name: Microsoft Advertising
vendors.purpose: measures the firm's ads and shows them to past visitors, only after a visitor accepts advertising
vendors.receives: pages visited, device and browser, IP address and the ad that brought the visitor; sets cookies; never what is typed into a form

vendors.name: LinkedIn
vendors.purpose: measures the firm's ads and shows them to past visitors, only after a visitor accepts advertising
vendors.receives: pages visited, device and browser, IP address, the ad that brought the visitor, and the buttons clicked and forms submitted on the page (LinkedIn's Website Actions, which cannot be switched off); sets cookies; never what is typed into a Fillout form

linkOnly.sanity.studio: hosted Studio addresses for the firm's editors; never loaded by a visitor
linkOnly.api.sanity.io: the content API, called by the server at build and render; never by a visitor's browser
linkOnly.schema.org: a structured data namespace, never fetched
linkOnly.youtu.be: short video links the site reads to find a video's id
linkOnly.fonts.google.com: font license attribution; fonts are served by the site itself
linkOnly.vercel.sh: a configuration schema address, never served
linkOnly.vercel.live: Vercel's own toolbar, which Vercel adds to preview deployments only; the security policy names it there and nowhere else, and no visitor of the firm's site loads it
linkOnly.jsdelivr.net: a configuration schema address, never served
linkOnly.nextjs.org: a documentation link in generated code
linkOnly.instagram.com: a link to the firm's profile; nothing loads from it
linkOnly.justia.com: a link to the firm's directory profile
linkOnly.avvo.com: a link to the firm's directory profile
linkOnly.martindale.com: a link to the firm's directory profile
linkOnly.findlaw.com: a link to the firm's directory profile
linkOnly.lawyers.com: a link to the firm's directory profile
linkOnly.superlawyers.com: a link to the firm's directory profile
linkOnly.lawinfo.com: a link to the firm's directory profile
linkOnly.yelp.com: a link to the firm's review profile
